what: Micro Machines (Codemasters): its boot code is unpacked to RAM $C000 and entered by CALL $C000 at ROM $8018; that code uploads the palette with OUT/OTIR, so the converter patches the unpacked copy at the entry (a RAM image taken at frame 10). The runtime's variables go to $DD00 (zero in every checkpoint of a played run, far from the stack at $DFFF): the default spot under $DFFF is stack once a Pause NMI nests on the boot code
